experimental_method: Water content of CO2 in equilibrium with hydrate measured with a chilled-mirror hygrometer on gas flowed from a 300 cm3 piston cell (T cycled over at least 20 h, N2 injected to hold pressure).
uncertainties_stated: Hygrometer dew/frost point resolution 0.1 K, accuracy +-0.2 K; circulator control +-0.1 K; no uncertainty stated for y_w.
quality_remarks: Authors question Song and Kobayashi data, which are about 1000e-6 higher than this work. Source file year 2011 (online); volume year 2012 used for source_key. Pressure transducer checked vs dead-weight tester.
